name: axin 2

function.text: AXIN2 encodes axin-2. Annotated molecular activities include molecular adaptor activity and I-SMAD binding. It participates in regulation of mismatch repair and odontogenesis.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to oligodontia-cancer predisposition syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: AXIN2 mutations have been reported in colorectal cancer, including mismatch-repair-deficient tumors. Variant-level interpretation is required.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Gene-specific alteration context described by NCBI/RefSeq; variant applicability requires review.
